EmailTemplate.name: Seasonal_CriticalDay_RedCrossLongSleeveTshirt_DonorOffer_Dec.16-Jan.3, 2025
EmailTemplate.subject: New Tee For Your Donors!
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hello {!Contact.FirstName},
Thank you for working hard to organize your upcoming blood drive. Your blood drive plays an important role during this time to ensure there are no delays in medical treatment for patients in need.
A blood donation is a gift that can give comfort and bring cheer to patients in need this holiday season.
When donors come to give blood Dec. 16 - Jan. 3, 2025, they'll receive a NEW long sleeved Red Cross T-shirt, while they last.*
As you continue the work to make your drive a success – remember to use these tips:
Share the attached email about this exciting incentive to recruit more blood donors! Fill your schedule. Use these tools to recruit blood donors and schedule them using the Blood Drive Management Portal. Encourage donors to schedule a donation for a friend. Each additional donor scheduled means more lives saved!
If you have any questions, please do not hesitate to reach out – I’m always here to help!
All the best,
{Account Manager Name}
*Subject to change. Offers applicable to presenting donors only during the dates above and while supplies last. T-shirt sizes are limited. Offers subject to availability of donation opportunities in presenting donor’s area. No substitutions and not transferable by presenting donor. Not redeemable for cash.
